T0592.title: Verifiable Credential
T0592.definition: A tamper-evident credential whose issuer, subject, claims, and status can be cryptographically verified.
T0592.description: Verifiable credentials use cryptographic proof to validate claims, issuers, and subjects for scenarios such as education, qualifications, membership, or device identity. Risks center on issuer trust, revocation, selective disclosure, wallet security, and privacy correlation when credentials are over-collected.
T0592.usageExample: Assess Verifiable Credential related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
